summary: Armada Acquisition Corp. II, a Cayman Islands blank-check company trading on Nasdaq under XRPNU/XRPN/XRPNW, filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026 reporting a Warrant Amendment with Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company as warrant agent. The amendment conforms Section 3.2 of the May 20, 2025 Warrant Agreement to the IPO prospectus, confirming warrants become exercisable on the later of the first business-combination closing date or twelve months after the public offering close. No deal terms, target, stake, price or board recommendation were disclosed; Item 3.03 incorporates the modification by reference. Watch for an initial business combination announcement and any further warrant or trust-related changes.
